verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs say self-hosted deployments run on your own LLM API keys ([skyvern-docs-2], [skyvern-docs-12]), and a hands-on user reports paying their own OpenAI bill ([skyvern-comm-1]), so bring-your-own-key is documented. Nothing shows which providers or models are supported, so model-agnosticism across vendors is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: a list of supported LLM providers or models, documentation for configuring non-OpenAI or local models, and independent corroboration of switching between vendors.
